generator: client/tools/vfx/build_spell_vfx.py (spell effects); tools/blender/spell_vfx.py (noise fields, legacy masks)
alpha_convention: straight (non-premultiplied) alpha; alpha is coverage and is linear; RGB of colour atlases is sRGB-encoded; masks/normals/flow are raw linear data
padding: every atlas cell carries a 4 px zero-alpha, zero-colour gutter and its content fades to zero before it, so mipmapping cannot bleed one cell's content into its neighbour
temporal_method: generated clips: consecutive frames of one continuous video sampled evenly over the effect's active span (no independent stills); looping atlases crossfade their tail into their head. Frames are ordered row-major and must be played in that order.
